profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Studios
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Asset Pipeline and Interoperability
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and technologist with deep experience in problem solving and overcoming technical challenges using a wide variety of programming languages, platforms, and techniques. Demonstrated success managing a team of developers in fast-paced environments. Passionate about leveraging software and technology for creative uses.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Asset Pipeline and Interoperability
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- One of the primary authors of Pixar’s integration of USD and Hydra into Autodesk Maya
- Founding member of and Pixar representative for the Technical Steering Committee of Autodesk’s open source maya-usd project
- Integrated Open Shading Language into the studio’s procedural geometry generation system for foliage and debris
- Extensive Maya plugin and tool development including viewport rendering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built client-side infrastructure, features, and user interfaces for the Nextdoor iOS app
- Constructed server-side APIs, features, and web frontends using Python, Django, and other web technologies
- Developed Google Maps-based tools for the web to support the company’s field operations
- Mentored and trained junior engineers on iOS app development using Objective-C

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developer on the team building the next generation of Poker and integrated casino games
- Coding responsibilities spanning both client and server, using C# and the Unity game engine for the frontend, and PHP and Java in the backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrated the Ptex open source texturing system into the studio's proprietary toolset and renderer. Worked closely with the rendering team to ensure full support for Ptex through rendering and shading, as well as transfer to and from the studio's proprietary texture map formats.
- Developed pipeline tools to simplify the adoption of Ptex by production and to streamline Ptex workflows.
- Overhauled and optimized the batch rendering system for the studio's next generation lighting application, Torch.

positions.title: Supervising Technical Director
positions.description:
- Represented production as a member of the program management team for development of the studio's next generation lighting tool, Torch.
- Led the team of TDs testing, developing plugins for, and creating artist-facing tools to integrate with Torch.

positions.title: Supervising Technical Director
positions.description:
- Managed a team of TDs at three studios across two continents, and was responsible for the overall technical health of the production "Puss in Boots."
- Collaborated with the visual effects supervisor and the CG department heads to assess and implement the technical needs of the production.
- Built out infrastructure and provided critical communication channels to support the studio's first cross-continentally produced animated feature film with our sister studio in Bangalore, India.
- Managed and developed talent in a team of over 30 TDs at all three studios.
- Helped develop techniques for achieving more realistic dynamic effects on character fur.

positions.title: Lead Technical Director
positions.description:
- Oversaw the backend departments and provided technical leadership in the lighting department on the production "Monsters vs. Aliens."
- Provided substantial contributions to the design and development of the studio's first stereoscopic lighting and compositing pipeline.
- Devised a system of templating the construction of batch render submission dependency graphs to simplify building the rig for large, complex sequences and shots, and to take advantage of reuse for commonly used techniques and patterns.
- Trained lighting artists and TDs across the studio on working in stereo.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
- Focused on lighting department support and pipeline development for the production "Bee Movie."
- Contributed development to shaders and pipeline tools to achieve waxy look for shots set in the bee hive.
- Developed a tool to simplify a 3D roto technique, allowing lighting artists to paint object-based masks to fine tune their lighting rigs.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
- Supported the animation and lighting departments and also functioned as a generalist TD for the production "Flushed Away."
- Developed a disk management utility still used today to track high volumes of production data (averaging on the order of 100TB per show).

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description:
- Functioned as a teaching assistant for "EECS 281: Data Structures and Algorithms."
- Prepared lesson plans and conducted discussion sections for students to supplement the material presented in lecture.
- Designed, developed, and maintained automated grading scripts and programs for the course's programming assignments.
- Held weekly office hours to assist and mentor students in small groups and on an individual basis.
- Graded student homework assignments and exams.
